where: Section 3, variable load and speed formula
problem: The formula is printed without exponents or markup: 'Pe = [ (P1p n1 t1 + P2p n2 t2 + …) / (n1 t1 + n2 t2 + …) ]1/p'. A student reads P1p as a product, and neither Pe nor Pi is defined, nor are their units.
fix: Write it with superscripts and define the symbols: P<sub>e</sub> = [ (P<sub>1</sub><sup>p</sup> n<sub>1</sub> t<sub>1</sub> + P<sub>2</sub><sup>p</sup> n<sub>2</sub> t<sub>2</sub> + …) / (n<sub>1</sub> t<sub>1</sub> + n<sub>2</sub> t<sub>2</sub> + …) ]<sup>1/p</sup>, where Pe is the equivalent load in N over the whole cycle, Pi is the equivalent load in step i in N, ni is the speed in that step in rpm, ti is the time spent in that step, and p = 3 for ball and 10/3 for roller bearings.

problem: C0 is defined using '0.0001 times the ball diameter', but this section covers roller bearings too, where the reference is the roller diameter, not a ball diameter.
fix: 'the load that leaves a permanent dent of 0.0001 times the rolling-element diameter (ball or roller) at the most heavily loaded contact.'
